body:
maria: FYI I rolled PR #6291 to canary at 01:12 UTC. Seeing p95 spike for short seq (8-16) on a few instances. Not in prod yet.
cheng: Do you have the perf run/artifacts?
maria: Quick gist of canary vs baseline from local canary run:
```
scenario: short_seq_8
baseline p95: 48ms
canary p95: 102ms
throughput: baseline 120 req/s, canary 118 req/s
memory RSS: baseline 1.9GB, canary 2.05GB
```
alex: hmm alloc path changed in the PR, maybe extra safeties. Logs show repeated "alloc_mutex contended" on hot path.
maria: example log snippet:
```
[2025-10-11T01:15:22Z] worker-7 WARN alloc_safety.cpp:127 handle_alloc_safeguard: took 1.8ms
[2025-10-11T01:15:22Z] worker-7 WARN runtime.cpp:402 alloc_mutex contended
```
sam: can we flip the runtime flag temporarily: `enable_alloc_safeguard=false` to see delta?
maria: I prepared a canary config patch to flip it; snippet:
```
runtime:
  alloc:
    enable_alloc_safeguard: false
    fast_path_threshold: 64
```
cheng: We should get @eng-oncall and @eng-sre eyes — toggling could mask a real mem bug.
bench-bot: scheduled perf-run/short_seq_8 on canary with flag flip; job id: br-6291-01
alex: :eyes: I'll generate a flamegraph and microbenchmark. If it drops p95 back to ~50ms that's strong signal.
ci-bot: perf-suite started (br-6291-01). ETA ~20m.
sam: Hold merge until we have the perf job and a rollback plan. If flag flip shows improvement, we can consider a quick revert or config change.
maria: Got it. I'll apply the flag on two canary hosts and post results here.
bench-bot: perf job br-6291-01 completed: canary+flag p95: 52ms, throughput 119 req/s, memory 2.01GB
alex: nice, looks like the safeguard is the culprit. :thumbsup:
cheng: please open a revert PR or a config-only patch and request approvals. Also add the flamegraph to the PR.
maria: Created PR #6292 (config flip) and linked microbench & flamegraph: https://ci/reports/6291/fg
sam: I'll review the revert/config PR now. If all good, we can merge and then schedule a proper fix in #6291.
maria: thanks everyone — will wait for reviews and close the canary hosts after merge.
